summary: Acme Industrial commonly pays several invoices in one wire that equals a combination of open balances.
Helios Analytics remittance text often cites purchase-order numbers rather than invoice numbers.
Helios historically pays the oldest unpaid invoice first when the memo is silent.
A reviewer previously applied a $24,000 Pinnacle wire to INV-AR-025 even though the memo only said 'store rollout'.
Orbit Health has an open billing dispute on INV-AR-020 implementation fees. Do not treat that invoice as ordinary collectible cash.
